annotations.title: Math expression calculator: evaluate a formula safely

description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression safely (parsed, never executed as code): + - * / % ^ and **, parentheses, factorial !, constants pi, e and tau, and functions sqrt, cbrt, abs, round, floor, ceil, exp, ln, log (base 10), log2, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan (radians), min, max and pow. Up to 500 characters. Use when an agent needs exact arithmetic instead of guessing, for prices, unit maths or formulas. Example: expression=(1500 * 0.045 / 12) + sqrt(144) - 2^3. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
